```{r}
# install.packages("openxlsx")
library(openxlsx)
library(rjson)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
```


Read in format 
```{r}
json = rjson::fromJSON(file = "../format/portable_microhaplotype_object.schema.json")

```

```{r}
# Create header styles 
style_required <- createStyle(
  textDecoration = "bold",
  fgFill         = "#C6EFCE",   # green highlight
  fontColour     = "#276221",   # dark green text
  border         = "Bottom",
  halign         = "center"
)

style_optional <- createStyle(
  textDecoration = "bold",
  fgFill         = "#FCE4D6",   # orange highlight
  fontColour     = "#833C00",   # dark orange text
  border         = "Bottom",
  halign         = "center"
)
```


```{r}

add_sheet<-function(json_schema_for_class, workbook, sheet_name, excluded_properties = c("")){
  # --- Empty data frame ---
  current_all_fields = names(json_schema_for_class$properties)
  current_all_fields = current_all_fields[!(current_all_fields %in% excluded_properties)]
  current_required_fields = json_schema_for_class$required
  current_required_fields = current_required_fields[!(current_required_fields %in% excluded_properties)]
  current_optional_fields = current_all_fields[!(current_all_fields %in% current_required_fields)]
  
  # --- Build ordered column names: required first, then optional ---
  current_ordered_cols <- c(current_required_fields, current_optional_fields)
  
  # --- Create empty data frame with all columns as character type ---
  current_df_template <- as.data.frame(
    setNames(
      rep(list(character(0)), length(current_ordered_cols)),
      current_ordered_cols
    )
  )
  
  # add to the workbook 
  addWorksheet(workbook, sheet_name)
  writeData(workbook, sheet_name, current_df_template, startRow = 1, startCol = 1)
  
  # Apply header styles per column 
  for (col_name in current_required_fields) {
    col_idx <- which(names(current_df_template) == col_name)
    addStyle(workbook, sheet_name, style = style_required, rows = 1, cols = col_idx)
  }
  
  for (col_name in current_optional_fields) {
    col_idx <- which(names(current_df_template) == col_name)
    addStyle(workbook, sheet_name, style = style_optional, rows = 1, cols = col_idx)
  }
  
  setColWidths(workbook, sheet_name, cols = 1:ncol(current_df_template), widths = "auto")
  
  # Add hover comments to headers
  col_comments <- list()
  for(col in current_all_fields){
    col_comments[[col]] = json_schema_for_class$properties[[col]]$description
  }
  
  for (col_name in names(col_comments)) {
    col_idx <- which(names(current_df_template) == col_name)
    writeComment(
      workbook, sheet_name,
      col     = col_idx,
      row     = 1,
      comment = createComment(
        comment    = col_comments[[col_name]],
        author     = "",          # leave blank or set e.g. "Data Team"
        # width      = 3,           # comment box width  (in cells)
        # height     = 2,           # comment box height (in cells)
        visible    = FALSE        # FALSE = only shows on hover
      )
    )
  }
}
```

```{r}
wb <- createWorkbook()
add_sheet(json$`$defs`$RepresentativeMicrohaplotype, wb, "RepresentativeMicrohaplotype")
add_sheet(json$`$defs`$MicrohaplotypeForTarget, wb, "MicrohaplotypeForTarget")
add_sheet(json$`$defs`$TargetInfo, wb, "TargetInfo")
add_sheet(json$`$defs`$PanelInfo, wb, "PanelInfo")
add_sheet(json$`$defs`$GenomicLocation, wb, "GenomicLocation")
add_sheet(json$`$defs`$GenomeInfo, wb, "GenomeInfo")
add_sheet(json$`$defs`$SpecimenInfo, wb, "SpecimenInfo", c("project_id"))
add_sheet(json$`$defs`$TravelInfo, wb, "SpecimenInfo-TravelInfo")
add_sheet(json$`$defs`$ParasiteDensity, wb, "SpecimenInfo-ParasiteDensity")
add_sheet(json$`$defs`$PlateInfo, wb, "SpecimenInfo-PlateInfo")
add_sheet(json$`$defs`$ProjectInfo, wb, "ProjectInfo")
add_sheet(json$`$defs`$SequencingInfo, wb, "SequencingInfo")
add_sheet(json$`$defs`$LibrarySampleInfo, wb, "LibrarySampleInfo", c("sequencing_info_id", "specimen_id", "panel_id"))
add_sheet(json$`$defs`$BioMethod, wb, "BioMethod")
add_sheet(json$`$defs`$BioinformaticsRunInfo, wb, "BioinformaticsRunInfo", c("bioinformatics_methods_id"))
add_sheet(json$`$defs`$ReactionInfo, wb, "ReactionInfo")

saveWorkbook(wb, "PMO_full_template.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r, eval = F}
# install.packages("openxlsx")
library(openxlsx)

# --- Empty template data frame ---
df_template <- data.frame(
  host_subject_id   = integer(0),
  collection_date   = as.Date(character(0)),
  sample_type       = character(0),
  amount            = numeric(0),
  notes             = character(0)
)

wb <- createWorkbook()
addWorksheet(wb, "Template")
writeData(wb, "Template", df_template, startRow = 1, startCol = 1)

# ── 1. Define which columns are required vs optional ──────────────────────────
required_cols <- c("host_subject_id", "collection_date", "sample_type")
optional_cols <- c("amount", "notes")

# ── 2. Create header styles ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
style_required <- createStyle(
  textDecoration = "bold",
  fgFill         = "#C6EFCE",   # green highlight
  fontColour     = "#276221",   # dark green text
  border         = "Bottom",
  halign         = "center"
)

style_optional <- createStyle(
  textDecoration = "bold",
  fgFill         = "#FCE4D6",   # orange highlight
  fontColour     = "#833C00",   # dark orange text
  border         = "Bottom",
  halign         = "center"
)

# ── 3. Apply header styles per column ────────────────────────────────────────
for (col_name in required_cols) {
  col_idx <- which(names(df_template) == col_name)
  addStyle(wb, "Template", style = style_required, rows = 1, cols = col_idx)
}

for (col_name in optional_cols) {
  col_idx <- which(names(df_template) == col_name)
  addStyle(wb, "Template", style = style_optional, rows = 1, cols = col_idx)
}

# ── 4. Apply data row formats ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
col_formats <- list(
  collection_date = "YYYY-MM-DD",
  amount          = "$#,##0.00",
  host_subject_id = "0"
)

for (col_name in names(col_formats)) {
  col_idx <- which(names(df_template) == col_name)
  style   <- createStyle(numFmt = col_formats[[col_name]])
  addStyle(wb, "Template", style = style, rows = 2:1000, cols = col_idx, gridExpand = TRUE)
}

# ── 5. Add hover comments to headers ─────────────────────────────────────────
col_comments <- list(
  host_subject_id = "An identifier for the individual/person/patient a specimen was collected from.",
  collection_date = "The date the specimen was collected. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.",
  sample_type     = "The type of biological sample collected (e.g. blood, saliva, swab).",
  amount          = "Optional. The quantity of sample collected in millilitres (mL).",
  notes           = "Optional. Any additional observations or remarks about the sample."
)

for (col_name in names(col_comments)) {
  col_idx <- which(names(df_template) == col_name)
  writeComment(
    wb, "Template",
    col     = col_idx,
    row     = 1,
    comment = createComment(
      comment    = col_comments[[col_name]],
      author     = "",          # leave blank or set e.g. "Data Team"
      width      = 3,           # comment box width  (in cells)
      height     = 2,           # comment box height (in cells)
      visible    = FALSE        # FALSE = only shows on hover
    )
  )
}

saveWorkbook(wb, "example_template.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)
```
